_caps: A grant never exceeds its table's cap (no day cap since 2026-09-23 — 体力 alone limits a day).
_drop_tables: 刷副本 (2026-10-15): what a beast won in a rerun leaves (rules/rerun.mjs), by the table its instance names (chapter.json sealed.rerun.drops). Each roll in `rolls` lands with its `chance` (an elite's `elite_chance` when it has one) and gives one thing: an `item` by weight (`n` its count, [lo, hi]), or an arm (`gear`): a rarity drawn by `rarity` (an elite by `elite_rarity`), then one of `gear`'s arms of that rarity (items.json `rarity`). Drawn from the run's seed, the room and the beast's place in it: the same run drops the same. Only 卷一 things.
_gongke_zero: The day's 功课 handed in at 练气零层 (Hanli, 2026-10-15: every hand-in visibly raises 修为 or 灵石): 零层 takes no 修为 (state.mjs addProgress), so it pays this table instead — a few 灵石, what a 外门 杂役 errand pays (修屋顶 5). From 一层 on, `gongke`.
_tale: 今日传闻 (design.md § 今日传闻): Ling writes no number. Each step pays the `tale` table and the finale the `tale_end` table, both capped; the whole tale never pays more than `cap` (a fifth step eats into the finale), and pay() scales it by the roots and the realm like any grant. One finale `drop`: the highest-tier entry at or below the player's realm (an item, or a card not held and of a root the player has), picked by the tale's id — and the finale also leaves a 符 and raises the 本命法宝 one 重 (`growth`). Raised 2026-09-24 (redesign-v2: the rumor is the day's main dish, the daily boards are gone): 15 a step, 30 the finale, 90 the cap — see `_economy`.
_stamina: 体力是控制单次游戏时长的: 1 体力 ≈ 1 分钟 (Hanli 2026-11-02: 「或者简单点, 给用户100体力, 1体力玩大约1分钟?」 · 「体力不要自动回, 只有闭关才回. 或者体力卡」 · 「完成任务不奖励体力」; design.md § 体力). `max` 100, and a spent pool rests until whole (`rest`). No clock refill (`refill.clock_hours` null): it comes back in 闭关 only — the real one (rules/seclusion.mjs) or time away, `refill.away_min` or more with no player verb counted as 闭关 for 体力 alone (state.mjs awayFit) — the whole pool in `refill.seclusion_hours`, linear on real minutes (2 h since 2026-11-04, Hanli: 「刚刚闭关12分钟, 体力加20, 这个调整一下吧」 · 「可以, 2小时回满」: 12 minutes +10; was 1 h). `refill.quest` false: no chore, 开府 row or app quest pays 体力, whatever its row says. `cost`: each act its minutes × `per_minute` (state.mjs staminaCost) — a word names balance.json model.minutes (`practice`: the practice board's; `reading`: the scene's own text at model.chars_per_min, plus `scene`; `board`: the board's own minutes as played, balance.json play_pay.game_minutes · minutes by its kind, state.mjs boardCost — Hanli 2026-11-04: 「小游戏有一些时间比较长的, 你看一下体力扣的是否对」), a number is the act's minutes where the model has none, `move` a trip by its roads. `step` 0: reading the story costs nothing (Hanli 2026-11-04: 「剧情保持不扣」; was its text at 450 字/分 + 1) — an exit's own `stamina` (toil) still costs. `qiecuo` 2: a 90-second bout and its door.
_her_card: 银月's card grows both ways (Hanli, 2026-09-24: 两个都做). `realm`: with the player's realm, as the player's 气血/灵力 grow — the lift at the highest realm listed at or below theirs (the fight's own realm table, battle.js REALMS, ends at 元婴, so hers does too). `gifts`: the story gives her an ability at the 3rd, 6th and 9th cauldron found, each costing one of her reflections (companion.json secret); `lift` is what it adds to her card in a fight. No relationship score (redesign-v2 § 四). Numbers weighed by the gate (tools/battle-sim.mjs § 银月). `gear` (Hanli 11-03: she wears 法器 · 法衣 · 佩 like him; the rates are the agent's pick, Hanli delegated): what she wears, on her card, by the item's own numbers — a 法器's 器攻 × `atk_per_atk` (rounded: 器攻 2–3 → +1, 1 → 0) to her 攻, a 法衣's 防 × `hp_per_def` (rounded: +1) to her 气血 — one realm step's size, the +1 a lift may be (content.mjs: +2/+2 won 97%) — and a 佩's 抗 × `ward_per_point` off each blow of that element on her card (at least 1 lands). tools/battle-sim.mjs --her: her full gear adds at most 4.3 points a step, but on that yardstick 筑基 goes 95.3% → 99.7% (the 元婴 rows were over the 97% line before her gear). A thing of hers adds its own `lift` on top (齐纨 +1 气血).

_seclusion: 闭关修炼 (his, 2026-09-24: one pick per seclusion; rules/seclusion.mjs). Real hours from the save's own stamp, at most `cap_hours`; under `min_hours` nothing grows but 体力. One focus: a 功法 gains a ★ per `star_hours` (to `star_top`; the hours left over wait for the next seclusion on that card), 修为 an hour's share of the layer he sits on (balance.json play_pay.seclusion: a `rest_hours` night is 10% of the layer since 2026-10-27, 数值系统 phase 2 — 闭关 is the idle fallback, play is the game), or the 本命法宝 one 重 per `treasure_hours` (left over kept). Any focus: 体力 comes back all through it, the whole pool in stamina.refill.seclusion_hours (until 2026-11-02 a `rest_hours` sitting filled it; `rest_hours` is now only the night 修为 is reckoned by). A pill in `pills` taken going in multiplies the hours counted (not the cap on real hours).

seclusion.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, seed 52, 768×512: a closed 洞府 stone gate in a cliff, pine and mist above, steps below, light at the seam.

_growth: 本命法宝 and 符 grow from the story, never from a daily tap (redesign-v2 § 四: 温养 · 强化 · 写符 cut). The treasure rises one 重 each time a chapter ends and each time 今日传闻's finale is won, up to 九重. A rumor's finale leaves one 符; a fight won leaves one on one win in `fight_one_in` (by the day, the beast and the 名字).
_pouch: 储物袋 (Hanli, 2026-09-25): the bag's room, counted in slots — one item id is one slot, stacks unlimited; a key, a thing the open chapter or a taken errand still needs, and her bell take none. `by_tier` is the room at each realm (the highest row at or below his); the one bigger pouch he wears (items.json `effect.pouch`) adds its slots — one at a time (Hanli 2026-11-04: 「储物袋不要叠加了」); 换上 another swaps it, the old one back in the bag as a thing. Full: a drop, a reward or a grant waits at the 洞府 (待取) until he taps it in; a find on the road and a purchase are refused. A 练气 player in 徐 holds 8–12 kinds; 24 is room to spare until the later provinces' materials pile up.
